request:
Saarbrücken-Reku is a German pathological-voice dataset containing clinically validated voice-disorder labels. Reku means Rekurrensparese (212 healthy, 212 pathological).
All recordings correspond to the sentence \textit{``Guten Morgen, wie geht es Ihnen?'' (``Good morning, how are you?'')} Keep the spoken content and evaluate all methods to summarize what works for this task.
reflections: formant_lpc: The user requests anonymization of German pathological voice recordings, skips run_mask, and asks to compare all methods. Related Saar-Lary and Saar-HD experience suggests pitch and formant_spec retain pathological cues better than NeuralVC or Resyn. Run all methods in sequence for a comprehensive comparison. Transcribe first for text and speaker information. Although masking is skipped and conversion is independent, transcription can help evaluation or ensure...
